'''Lothair Mantelar''' was a strict ascetic and proselytizer who lived during the [[War of the Hundred Years]]. His homeland and many of the details of his life are not known, but he is infamous in history as the founder of the [[Children of the Light]].

== History ==
Mantelar believed that the chaos of the civil war to seize control of [[Artur Hawkwing's Empire]] was allowing the [[Shadow]] to gain root and flourish amongst the people. He outlined his vision of the simple, humble lives that people should lead in the name of the [[Light]] in a book called ''[[The Way of the Light]]'', which gained some popularity during those dark times, although its assertion that touching the [[True Source]] was provenance of the [[Creator]] alone and that any who dared wield the [[One Power]] were servants of the [[Dark One]] (including all [[Aes Sedai]]) was controversial. Mantelar founded the Children of the Light in {{Fy|1021}} as a preaching organization dedicated to spreading the word of the Light and to rooting out [[Darkfriend]]s. Due to the ongoing military conflict, the Children found themselves having to learn how to fight to defend themselves, but as the decades passed the Children transformed from a simple preaching group to a militarized organization of crusaders. In {{Fy|1111}}, presumably long after Mantelar's death, the group had formally become a military order dedicated to the destruction of Darkfriends and also the Aes Sedai.

==Parallel==
Lothair Mantelar's name seems to be an allusion to Martin Luther, father of the Protestant Reformation.
